name: CSO_CONTENT_REC
description: This table is used to track content recommendations that have been submitted to request new content to be created.

columns.name: SITE_ID
columns.description: The repository associated with the request.

columns.name: CASE_NUMBER
columns.description: An external identifier associated with the recommendation request.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: This is the user provided comment regarding the recommendation.

columns.name: COMPLETED_USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID for the userinformation record of the user that completed the recommendation.

columns.name: COMPLETED_USER_NAME
columns.description: De-normalized user name for the user that completed the content recommendation.

columns.name: CONTENT_CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: This is the Reference to content channel record.

columns.name: CONTENT_ID
columns.description: This is the Reference to content table record.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was modified.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: This is the user assigned priority for completing the recommendation. Valid values: 0=low; 1=medium; 2=high

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: REQUEST_USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID of the user that made the recommendation.

columns.name: REQUEST_USER_NAME
columns.description: De-normalized name of the user that made the recommendation.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: The status of the recommendation. Valid values: 1= new; 2=rejected duplicate; 3=rejected not enough info; 4=rejected unsuitable; 5=rejected other; 6=content created.

columns.name: TASK_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID to the task that was created as a result of the recommendation.

columns.name: TITLE
columns.description: This is the title of the recommendation.

columns.name: STATUS_COMMENTS
columns.description: This is the user comments associated with the recommendation status.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: This is the Reference to locale table record.

columns.name: COMPLETED_USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user that completed the recommendation.

columns.name: REQUEST_USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user that made the recommendation.
